simetri.base.all_enums

String enumerations used across Simetri graphics, canvas, and backends.

Most enums are StrEnum members whose .value is the string written to SVG/TikZ or used for style resolution. Use get_enum_value to accept either an enum member or a case-insensitive name string.

Examples:
>>> import simetri.graphics as sg
>>> sg.get_enum_value(sg.Anchor, "center")
'center'
>>> sg.Anchor.NORTHWEST.value
'northwest'

   1"""String enumerations used across Simetri graphics, canvas, and backends.
   2
   3Most enums are ``StrEnum`` members whose ``.value`` is the string
   4written to SVG/TikZ or used for style resolution. Use ``get_enum_value``
   5to accept either an enum member or a case-insensitive name string.
   6
   7Examples:
   8    >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
   9    >>> sg.get_enum_value(sg.Anchor, "center")
  10    'center'
  11    >>> sg.Anchor.NORTHWEST.value
  12    'northwest'
  13"""
  14
  15from __future__ import annotations
  16
  17from enum import StrEnum
  18from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, TypeAlias, Union
  19
  20if TYPE_CHECKING:
  21    from simetri.base.core import Base
  22    from simetri.geom.segments.line_utils import Edge
  23    from simetri.group.batch import Group
  24    from simetri.helpers.illustration import Tag
  25    from simetri.shapes.shape import Shape
  26
  27
  28def get_enum_value(enum_class: StrEnum, value: str) -> str:
  29    """Resolve an enum member or name string to its string value.
  30
  31    Args:
  32        enum_class: The ``StrEnum`` subclass to look up.
  33        value: An enum member or a case-insensitive member name.
  34
  35    Returns:
  36        str: The enum's ``.value`` string.
  37
  38    Raises:
  39        KeyError: If ``value`` is a string that does not match a member name.
  40
  41    Examples:
  42        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
  43        >>> get_enum_value(sg.Types, sg.Types.SHAPE)
  44        'SHAPE'
  45        >>> get_enum_value(sg.Types, "circle")
  46        'CIRCLE'
  47    """
  48    if isinstance(value, enum_class):
  49        res = value.value
  50    else:
  51        res = enum_class[value.upper()].value
  52
  53    return res
  54
  55
  56class Align(StrEnum):
  57    """Align is used to set the alignment of the text in tags.
  58    Used for Tag and Text objects. This is based on TikZ.
  59
  60    Valid values are: NONE, CENTER, FLUSH_CENTER, FLUSH_LEFT, FLUSH_RIGHT, JUSTIFY, LEFT, RIGHT.
  61
  62    Examples:
  63        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
  64        >>> sg.Align.BOTTOM.value
  65        'bottom'
  66    """
  67
  68    BOTTOM = "bottom"
  69    CENTER = "center"
  70    FLUSH_CENTER = "flush center"
  71    FLUSH_LEFT = "flush left"
  72    FLUSH_RIGHT = "flush right"
  73    HORIZ_CENTER = "horiz center"
  74    JUSTIFIED = "justified"
  75    LEFT = "left"
  76    NONE = ""
  77    RIGHT = "right"
  78    TOP = "top"
  79    VERT_CENTER = "vert center"
  80
  81
  82# Anchor points
  83# Used for TikZ. VaLUeS are case sensitive.
  84class Anchor(StrEnum):
  85    """Anchor is used to set the anchor point of the shapes
  86    relative to the boundary box of shapes/groups or
  87    frames of tag objects.
  88
  89    Valid values are: BASE, BASE_EAST, BASE_WEST, BOTTOM, CENTER, EAST, LEFT, MID,
  90    NORTH,
  91    NORTHEAST, NORTHWEST, RIGHT, SOUTH, SOUTHEAST, SOUTHWEST, TEXT, TOP, WEST.
  92
  93    Examples:
  94        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
  95        >>> sg.Anchor.BASE.value
  96        'base'
  97    """
  98
  99    BASE = "base"  # FOR TAGS ONLY
 100    BASE_EAST = "base east"  # FOR TAGS ONLY
 101    BASE_WEST = "base west"  # FOR TAGS ONLY
 102    BOTTOM = "bottom"
 103    MIDPOINT = "midpoint"
 104    EAST = "east"
 105    LEFT = "left"
 106    CENTER = "center"
 107    NORTH = "north"
 108    NORTHEAST = "northeast"
 109    NORTHWEST = "northwest"
 110    RIGHT = "right"
 111    SOUTH = "south"
 112    SOUTHEAST = "southeast"
 113    SOUTHWEST = "southwest"
 114    TEXT = "text"
 115    TOP = "top"
 116    WEST = "west"
 117

 119class ArrowLine(StrEnum):
 120    """ArrowLine is used to set the type of arrow line.
 121
 122    Valid values are: FLATBASE_END, FLATBASE_MIDDLE, FLATBASE_START, FLATBOTH_END, FLATBOTH_MIDDLE,
 123    FLATBOTH_START, FLATTOP_END, FLATTOP_MIDDLE,     FLATTOP_START, STRAIGHT_END, STRAIGHT_MIDDLE, STRAIGHT_START.
 124
 125    Examples:
 126        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
 127        >>> sg.ArrowLine.FLATBASE_END.value
 128        'flatbase end'
 129    """
 130
 131    FLATBASE_END = "flatbase end"  # FLAT BASE, ARROW AT THE END
 132    FLATBASE_MIDDLE = "flatbase middle"  # FLAT BASE, ARROW AT THE MIDDLE
 133    FLATBASE_START = "flatbase start"  # FLAT BASE, ARROW AT THE START
 134    FLATBOTH_END = "flatboth end"
 135    FLATBOTH_MIDDLE = "flatboth middle"
 136    FLATBOTH_START = "flatboth start"
 137    FLATTOP_END = "flattop end"  #  FLAT TOP, ARROW AT THE END
 138    FLATTOP_MIDDLE = "flattop middle"
 139    FLATTOP_START = "flattop start"
 140    STRAIGHT_END = "straight end"  # DEFAULT, STRAIGHT LINE, ARROW AT THE END
 141    STRAIGHT_MIDDLE = "straight middle"  # STRAIGHT LINE, ARROW AT THE MIDDLE
 142    STRAIGHT_START = "straight start"  # STRAIGHT LINE, ARROW AT THE START
 143

 145class Axis(StrEnum):
 146    """Cartesian coordinate system axes.
 147
 148    Valid values are: X, Y.
 149
 150    Examples:
 151        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg

 677    RGBA = "RGBA"  # 4x8 bits per pixel (true color with transparency mask)

 679    YCbCr = "YCbCr"  # 3x8 bits per pixel (color video format)
 680    LAB = "LAB"  # 3x8 bits per pixel (CIE L*a*b* color space)
 681    HSV = "HSV"  # 3x8 bits per pixel (Hue, Saturation, Value color space)
 682    # * Hue's range of 0-255 is a scaled version of 0 degrees <= Hue < 360 degrees
 683    I = "I"  # 32 bits per pixel (32-bit signed integer pixels)  # noqa: E741
 684    F = "F"  # 32 bits per pixel (floating point pixels)
 685    # limited support for the following modes:

 687    PA = "PA"  # P with alpha
 688    RGBX = "RGBX"  # true color with padding
 689    RGBa = "RGBa"  # true color with premultilied alpha
 690    La = "La"  # L with premultilied alpha
 691    I_16 = "I;16"  # 16 bits per pixel (16-bit signed integer pixels)
 692    I_16L = "I;16L"  # 16 bits per pixel (16-bit signed integer pixels)
 693    I_16B = "I;16B"  # 16 bits per pixel (16-bit unsigned integer pixels)

1064class PageSize(StrEnum):
1065    """Page sizes for the LaTeX documents.
1066    Used in Page class.
1067
1068    Valid values are: LETTER, LEGAL, EXECUTIVE, B0, B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7, B8, B9, B10, B11, B12, B13,
1069    A0, A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6.
1070    Examples:
1071        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1072        >>> sg.PageSize.LETTER.value
1073        'letterpaper'
1074    """
1075
1076    LETTER = "letterpaper"
1077    LEGAL = "legalpaper"
1078    EXECUTIVE = "executivepaper"
1079    B0 = "b0paper"
1080    B1 = "b1paper"
1081    B2 = "b2paper"
1082    B3 = "b3paper"
1083    B4 = "b4paper"
1084    B5 = "b5paper"
1085    B6 = "b6paper"
1086    B7 = "b7paper"
1087    B8 = "b8paper"
1088    B9 = "b9paper"
1089    B10 = "b10paper"
1090    B11 = "b11paper"
1091    B12 = "b12paper"
1092    B13 = "b13paper"
1093    A0 = "a0paper"
1094    A1 = "a1paper"
1095    A2 = "a2paper"
1096    A3 = "a3paper"
1097    A4 = "a4paper"
1098    A5 = "a5paper"
1099    A6 = "a6paper"
1100
1101    def in_points(self) -> tuple[float, float]:
1102        """Return ``(width, height)`` in points, portrait.
1103
1104        ISO sizes are millimetres. Letter, legal, and executive are
1105        inches. One inch is 72 points.
1106
1107        Returns:
1108            tuple[float, float]: Width and height in points.
1109
1110        Examples:
1111            >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1112            >>> sg.PageSize.A3.in_points()
1113            (841.89, 1190.55)
1114            >>> sg.PageSize.LETTER.in_points()
1115            (612.0, 792.0)
1116        """
1117        if self in _PAGE_SIZE_MM:
1118            width_mm, height_mm = _PAGE_SIZE_MM[self]
1119            return (
1120                _millimetres_to_points(width_mm),
1121                _millimetres_to_points(height_mm),
1122            )
1123        width_in, height_in = _PAGE_SIZE_INCHES[self]
1124        return (
1125            float(width_in * _POINTS_PER_INCH),
1126            float(height_in * _POINTS_PER_INCH),
1127        )
1128
1129
1130_POINTS_PER_INCH = 72
1131_MM_PER_INCH = 25.4
1132
1133
1134def _millimetres_to_points(millimetres: float) -> float:
1135    """Convert millimetres to points at 72 points per inch."""
1136    return round(millimetres * _POINTS_PER_INCH / _MM_PER_INCH, 2)
1137

1742    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
1743        if isinstance(other, str):
1744            if (
1745                self.value == "GROUP"
1746                and other == "BATCH"
1747                or self.value == "BATCH"
1748                and other == "GROUP"
1749            ):
1750                return True
1751            return self.value == other
1752
1753        # 2. Handle standard Enum comparison
1754        return super().__eq__(other)
1755
1756    __hash__ = str.__hash__

1976class WarningType:
1977    """Namespace of warning subgroups; each subgroup is a ``StrEnum`` of leaves.
1978
1979    Toggle one leaf or a whole subgroup::
1980
1981        set_warning_off(WarningType.group.duplicate)
1982        set_warning_off(WarningType.group)
1983        set_warning_off(WarningType.style.line_fill_color)
1984
1985    Use ``sg.doc(WarningType.canvas)`` for a subgroup, or
1986    ``sg.doc(WarningType.canvas.save_path)`` for one leaf.
1987    Examples:
1988        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1989        >>> sg.WarningType.style.line_fill_color.value
1990        'style.line_fill_color'
1991    """

1994    deprecation = _DeprecationWarnings
1995    file = _FileWarnings

1998    group = _GroupWarnings
1999    output = _OutputWarnings

2001    util = _UtilWarnings

def get_enum_value(enum_class: enum.StrEnum, value: str) -> str: 
29def get_enum_value(enum_class: StrEnum, value: str) -> str:
30    """Resolve an enum member or name string to its string value.
31
32    Args:
33        enum_class: The ``StrEnum`` subclass to look up.
34        value: An enum member or a case-insensitive member name.
35
36    Returns:
37        str: The enum's ``.value`` string.
38
39    Raises:
40        KeyError: If ``value`` is a string that does not match a member name.
41
42    Examples:
43        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
44        >>> get_enum_value(sg.Types, sg.Types.SHAPE)
45        'SHAPE'
46        >>> get_enum_value(sg.Types, "circle")
47        'CIRCLE'
48    """
49    if isinstance(value, enum_class):
50        res = value.value
51    else:
52        res = enum_class[value.upper()].value
53
54    return res

Resolve an enum member or name string to its string value.

Arguments:
  • enum_class: The StrEnum subclass to look up.
  • value: An enum member or a case-insensitive member name.
Returns:

str: The enum's .value string.

Raises:
  • KeyError: If value is a string that does not match a member name.
Examples:
>>> import simetri.graphics as sg
>>> get_enum_value(sg.Types, sg.Types.SHAPE)
'SHAPE'
>>> get_enum_value(sg.Types, "circle")
'CIRCLE'

663class ImageMode(StrEnum):

677    RGB = "RGB"  # 3x8 bits per pixel (true color)
678    RGBA = "RGBA"  # 4x8 bits per pixel (true color with transparency mask)
679    CMYK = "CMYK"  # 4x8 bits per pixel (color separation)
680    YCbCr = "YCbCr"  # 3x8 bits per pixel (color video format)
681    LAB = "LAB"  # 3x8 bits per pixel (CIE L*a*b* color space)
682    HSV = "HSV"  # 3x8 bits per pixel (Hue, Saturation, Value color space)
683    # * Hue's range of 0-255 is a scaled version of 0 degrees <= Hue < 360 degrees
684    I = "I"  # 32 bits per pixel (32-bit signed integer pixels)  # noqa: E741
685    F = "F"  # 32 bits per pixel (floating point pixels)
686    # limited support for the following modes:
687    LA = "LA"  # L with alpha
688    PA = "PA"  # P with alpha
689    RGBX = "RGBX"  # true color with padding
690    RGBa = "RGBa"  # true color with premultilied alpha
691    La = "La"  # L with premultilied alpha
692    I_16 = "I;16"  # 16 bits per pixel (16-bit signed integer pixels)
693    I_16L = "I;16L"  # 16 bits per pixel (16-bit signed integer pixels)
694    I_16B = "I;16B"  # 16 bits per pixel (16-bit unsigned integer pixels)
695    I_16N = "I;16N"  # 16 bits per pixel (16-bit unsigned integer pixels)

1977class WarningType:
1978    """Namespace of warning subgroups; each subgroup is a ``StrEnum`` of leaves.
1979
1980    Toggle one leaf or a whole subgroup::
1981
1982        set_warning_off(WarningType.group.duplicate)
1983        set_warning_off(WarningType.group)
1984        set_warning_off(WarningType.style.line_fill_color)
1985
1986    Use ``sg.doc(WarningType.canvas)`` for a subgroup, or
1987    ``sg.doc(WarningType.canvas.save_path)`` for one leaf.
1988    Examples:
1989        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1990        >>> sg.WarningType.style.line_fill_color.value
1991        'style.line_fill_color'
1992    """
1993
1994    canvas = _CanvasWarnings
1995    deprecation = _DeprecationWarnings
1996    file = _FileWarnings

Namespace of warning subgroups; each subgroup is a StrEnum of leaves.

Toggle one leaf or a whole subgroup::

set_warning_off(WarningType.group.duplicate)
set_warning_off(WarningType.group)
set_warning_off(WarningType.style.line_fill_color)

Use sg.doc(WarningType.canvas) for a subgroup, or sg.doc(WarningType.canvas.save_path) for one leaf.

Examples:
>>> import simetri.graphics as sg
>>> sg.WarningType.style.line_fill_color.value
'style.line_fill_color'
